artworks.title: Ajax and Cassandra
artworks.description: Solomon's sack of Troy — the Locrian Ajax tears Cassandra from Athena's sanctuary, the sacrilege that brought the thunderbolt and the Gyraean rocks.

artworks.title: Ajax and Cassandra (Attic red-figure cup, Louvre G 458)
artworks.description: Attic cup — Ajax dragging Cassandra from the Palladium, the Little Ajax crime already fixed in clay.

artworks.title: Ajax Slain by Poseidon
artworks.description: Genelli's nostos punishment — Poseidon shattering the Locrian's rock after Athena's wrath at Cassandra's rape.

artworks.title: Ajax the Lesser, Son of Oileus
artworks.description: Sabatelli's Neoclassical Locrian — the lesser Ajax isolated as the warrior whose sacrilege outlived his courage.

artworks.title: Locrian Ajax
artworks.description: French academic study of Ajax Locrien — the Oilean hero whose name means Athena's violated altar.
